summary_en: Prudential Life Insurance and PGF Life (Prudential Gibraltar Financial Life) announced on 11 October 2024 that they had signed an insurance agency agreement. From 1 November 2024, Prudential Life will sell a PGF Life product for the first time. The product is "Index Annuity PGF", a US-dollar-denominated individual annuity linked to the S&P 500 with a cap on gains. Its S&P 500-linked investment continues during the annuity payout period. Premiums are paid in yen, and the product carries exchange-rate risk and fees.

summary_en: On 20 June 2025, Prudential Life Insurance Company of Japan said a third party exploited a vulnerability in its mobile device management server and gained unauthorized access on 16 May. The company found the breach on 20 May. The access exposed the names, user IDs and company email addresses of 11,919 current and former employees, some contractor staff and others. No customer information was involved. The server was cut off from the internet and fixed, and the company has individually notified those affected. It has seen no secondary harm so far.

title_ja: 弊社の業務委託先におけるランサムウェア被害による個人情報漏えいについて
title_en: Personal information leak due to ransomware attack at our outsourcing contractor
summary_en: On 8 December 2025, Prudential Life Insurance announced that its contractor Shinchosha, which handles claims and benefit verification work, lost customer data in a ransomware attack found on 27 June 2025. The leak covers 238 records. Depending on the record, it includes names, addresses, phone numbers, medical information, medical institution names and policy numbers. No secondary harm has been confirmed. Affected customers are to be notified individually by mail around the end of 2025.

title_en: Efforts toward reforms to restore trust
summary_en: First public disclosure. Following customer checks run since August 2024, the company reports misconduct by current and former sales staff: three former employees defrauded customers (8 victims, about 60 million yen) and 106 staff or ex-staff took money in ways unrelated to insurance business (about 1.63bn yen while employed, 1.45bn after leaving). President Mabara steps down 1 Feb 2026; Tokumaru, then head of PGF Life, succeeds him.

summary_en: Prudential Life Insurance Co. of Japan announced on 16 March 2026 that, because of a compensation calculation error, pay to some current and former sales employees fell below the legal minimum wage. People employed between 1 December 2018 and 30 November 2025 are covered. Individual notices to former employees are being mailed from mid-March 2026. Shortfalls from December 2018 pay onward will be paid in sequence from April 2026. Anyone who has not received a notice by around the end of April 2026 is asked to call the special help desk.

title_ja: お客さまへの補償の進捗状況について
title_en: Progress on compensation to customers
summary_en: On 22 April 2026, Prudential Holding of Japan, Prudential Life and Gibraltar Life reported on compensation for customers harmed by money-related misconduct by current and former sales staff. Of the 498 customers (¥3.08bn) affected by cases Prudential Life disclosed on 16 January, 259 (¥1.70bn) had completed review or compensation as of 17 April. About 700 inquiries are awaiting fact-checking, including about 70 involving Gibraltar Life. The groups aim to finish compensation by autumn 2026 and to publish progress roughly quarterly.

title_en: Apology and notice regarding the leak of customers' personal information by a former sales employee of the company
summary_en: On 14 September 2026, Prudential Life announced a follow-up to its 7 July disclosure. A former Tama branch sales employee, who left in March 2026, had taken customer documents out of the company while employed and later lost them; the company learned of it in June 2026 when someone who found the documents contacted it. The data covered 1,570 customers, including names, contact details, products and policy numbers. All documents were recovered and contacts on his phone deleted; as of 11 September no secondary harm or misuse was found.

title_ja: 社外特別調査委員会による調査報告書の受領について
title_en: Receipt of the investigation report by the external special investigation committee
summary_en: Prudential Life Insurance Japan announced on 5 October 2026 that it received a report from its external special investigation committee on 3 October. The report covers the facts, causes and recurrence-prevention measures for the financial misconduct by current and former sales staff. The company plans to publish the full report, with redactions for personal data and trade secrets, on 8 October 2026. It will also hold a press briefing that day on its recurrence-prevention progress and next steps.

title_ja: 社外特別調査委員会による調査報告書の公表およびお客さま本位の業務運営の徹底に向けた取り組みについて
title_en: Publication of the external special investigation committee's report
summary_en: Prudential Life publishes the outside special investigation committee's report and its response. The committee calls the problem structural (business model, pay, branch management, head office governance); 146 staff and ex-staff involved in the 16 January cases were disciplined, and the president and two vice-presidents return 30% of monthly pay for three months. Restart of sales is conditional on checks; pay reform from 2027.
